playground.note: switchSync is the locale commit plus every reactive text rebind, measured synchronously. switchToPainted adds two animation frames, so its floor is ~33ms on a 60Hz display and it measures paint, not i18n work.

bundles.note: gzip of every emitted .js chunk, measured with zlib.gzipSync at default level. Baseline is commit fae50a96 (the last main before any i18n work).

workbench.note: single chunk; the workbench predates the i18n work in this repo and its baseline is not comparable across the repo boundary

catalogs.note: source-file gzip; both catalogs ship in the bundle because the Playground and Admin switch languages at runtime with no network fetch
